title: Multiple journeys and optional travel dates
checks: Build: 37 pages; all 28 site tests passed.
Legacy migration is read-only until the first save; original v1 storage key preserved. Corrupt v2 does not silently fall back to v1.
Unit tests: separate trips, selected ID, add/delete/10-trip limit, per-trip data isolation, backup round-trip, invalid collections, unavailable storage and quota failure.
Calendar tests: invalid dates, leap days, month/year rollover and unscheduled ideas; UTC calculations avoid daylight-saving day shifts.
Browser: create journey, set start date, assign day, switch to unchanged original, reload selected journey and verify dated headings in page and print content.
Browser: save Pakhala from its page into the selected trip; current trip name displayed beside save control.

Browser: old single-trip file imported as a third trip without replacing either existing plan; full collection backup restoration confirmed. All synthetic trips then removed by restoring the initial empty collection.
Desktop screenshot inspected; compact browser reported 582 CSS px (requested 390), no horizontal overflow and stacked trip controls.
limitations: Actual native PDF output and A4 pagination remain unverified: embedded browser printing was unavailable in the previous batch.
Physical devices, exact 390px viewport and screen-reader testing remain outstanding.
Start date plus day numbering only; separate end dates, bookings, routing, sync and offline caching remain deferred.
Browser quota may prevent saving a large collection; keep a downloaded backup. No account or server storage introduced.
No public deployment, merge or push.
